King_Verse_1.Name: Deltas Hymn to the Divine King
King_Verse_1.Text:
O heavens! O suns! Joy is ours,
For a Sun of our own,
Eternal, of the Serpent's disintegration,
Walks the earth.

O waters! River Poison and River Fire,
Became his Blood.
In this confluence, was he, O Anghu.

As the Dawnbird, shaped his own egg
And named himself.

King_Verse_2.Name: Deltas Hymn to the Divine King
King_Verse_2.Text:
O stone! Sandstone and Slate,
Became his Flesh.
In this confluence, was he built, O Anghu.
An Aspect of Anghu's Anghu, 
A Lord of his own shaping.

O metal! Gold and Cold Iron,
Star-made, became his Kingdom.
In this confluence, rose we of gold, O Anghu.
Suckled by his Teat, named by his Naming
We Ashk'lani.
